sources.title: Effect of a compliant substrate on the rebound of a spherical shell
sources.license: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0 paper metadata; original PDF outside repository.
sources.tested: Source assessment only. Figure 8 spin data not digitized; no new prediction claimed.
sources.experiment: 40 mm diameter, 2.7 g ABS shell against bare glass or 0.50/0.96/1.25/1.78 mm silicone layers.
sources.parameter_provenance: mu~.92, local stiffness/effective mass and derived shear modulus are fitted from rebound/spin results, not independently measured input properties.
sources.model_relevance: Compliant local tangential displacement/pressure history changes spin transfer while keeping global bodies rigid; promising comparison for reduced local memory, pending independent inputs and data extraction.
